# StaneAI

> StaneAI (StaneAI Private Limited, also written "Stane AI") is an Indian AI and software products company founded in 2026. It builds mobile apps for Android and iOS, AI and workflow automation, AI chatbots and custom software for startups and small and growing businesses in India and the United States. Website: https://staneai.in

Key facts:

- Legal name: StaneAI Private Limited
- Founded: 2026
- Country: India; works with clients in India and the United States
- Focus: mobile applications (Android and iOS), AI automation, AI chatbots, custom software
- Approach: product-led, AI-enabled, mobile-first; builds focused MVPs first, then improves them with real user feedback
- Languages: English and Hindi
- Contact: contact@staneai.in (new projects), support@staneai.in (support)
- Tagline: "Ideas into intelligent products."

## Services

- [Mobile App Development](https://staneai.in/mobile-app-development/): Android and iOS apps, cross-platform (Flutter / React Native) and native, from MVP to launch
- [AI & Workflow Automation](https://staneai.in/ai-automation/): automating repetitive business tasks with AI and integrations
- [AI Chatbot Development](https://staneai.in/ai-chatbot-development/): customer-support and business chatbots built on company knowledge
- [Software Development](https://staneai.in/software-development/): custom web software, dashboards and internal tools
